visual.name: scorecardComments
visual.description: Read-first comment feed for the Executive Scorecard: no region tags, no author line, and posting happens in a dialog behind an Add comment button. Shares the board_comments table with OTIF Actions & Comments but carries its own GUID so the two version independently. GUID is deliberately short - it appears TWICE in the CustomVisuals path Power BI Desktop writes on save, and the full-length form pushed this report past the 256-char Windows limit.
